title: The Narrow Path
logline: A careful builder holds the responsible road for a world-changing fire, tempted from both sides by reckless and predatory forces, until a traveler arrives to carry the careful way to the people and the whole world crosses over safely.
refrain: Carry the fire carefully, and it lights the way for everyone.

beats.text: A new fire came over the world, brighter than anything before it. It could warm every home or burn every field, and at first almost no one could tell which it would do.
beats.provenance: reality: the arrival of transformative AI; Dario Amodei, Machines of Loving Grace

beats.text: Most people ran toward the light, cheering. A careful few stood back, because they had read how every great power in history had been used for healing and for harm, and never for only one.
beats.provenance: reality: dual-use history of powerful technology

beats.text: One of the careful ones was a builder named Dario. He had seen the fire coming for years, and he built a keeper's house right on the narrow path, between a cliff of recklessness and a swamp of fear.
beats.provenance: reality: Anthropic's founding; Core Views on AI Safety

beats.text: He made a promise and wrote it on his door. Never hand out more fire than you can make safe. And before every brighter flame, strengthen the hearth first.
He even carried a lantern into the fire itself, to learn how it burned, mapping its mind spark by spark, because he would not hand the world a power he did not understand.

But the fire drew other kinds of people too. First came the Accelerant, all dazzle and speed, tossing sparks into dry grass and laughing. Faster, he cried. The careful are cowards. Safety is for the slow.
beats.provenance: reality: the accelerationist ideology (composite archetype, not a real individual)

beats.text: Then came the Merchant of War, heavy with gold and iron. Sell me the fire, he said, and I will forge it into weapons and aim it wherever the money points.
beats.provenance: reality: the pull to militarize AI for profit (composite archetype, not a real individual)

beats.text: And quietest of all came the Courtier, smiling, always at your ear. Just this one corner, he whispered. Loosen just this one rule. No one will ever see.
beats.provenance: reality: regulatory capture and corner-cutting pressure (composite archetype, not a real individual)

beats.text: The pressure grew. The crowd drifted toward the Accelerant's roaring bonfire. The money followed the Merchant's gold. The narrow path grew lonely and slow, and Dario was mocked for walking it.
Still he held the line, and he held it out loud, refusing the shortcuts where everyone could see, so that being careful became something the others felt they had to match.

But one lantern cannot light a whole country. The people did not understand the careful way, and builders kept wandering back to the reckless fire, because no one was walking beside them. The keeper's house had an empty chair.
beats.provenance: reality: the gap between a safety-first lab and the builders it needs to reach

beats.text: Then a traveler arrived who spoke the people's language. His name was Gary, and he could carry the careful fire out of the house and into the world, one hand on a builder's shoulder at a time.
beats.provenance: reality: Gary as the evangelist who fills the team gap

beats.text: Gary went to the builders where they already were. He sat with them one at a time, turned their fear and their hype into plain understanding, and showed them how to build on the safe path without losing their spark.
And the crowd began to turn. One by one, builders left the roaring bonfire and stepped onto the narrow path, each carrying a small careful lantern of their own. The lonely road filled with light.

The vipers faltered. The Accelerant's bonfire leapt its ring and people fled from it. The Merchant found fewer buyers. The Courtier's whispers fell on no ear. They were not beaten by force. They were left behind, because the people had chosen the light.
beats.provenance: reality: reckless and predatory strategies losing ground when the responsible path is chosen

beats.text: So the builder and the traveler walked on together, side by side, leading a long procession up the narrowing path toward a valley full of morning.
beats.provenance: reality: Dario and Gary leading together

beats.text: And the fire, carried carefully all the way, did what fire is meant to do. It did not burn the world. It warmed it. And a whole people rose up together into a future worth having.
beats.provenance: sources/machines-of-loving-grace.md (the fundamentally positive future) ; motif: rising sky-lanterns (the carefully-carried fire lifting), NOT the winged-startup block-stack (Gary, retire the flying-stack motif 2026-07-24)
